content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which required authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome, alongside a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to evaluate the efficacy of current rate-control management."}
